input: Schedule my annual blood pressure check

gold.taskTitle: Schedule My Annual Blood Pressure Check
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book an appointment for their yearly blood pressure check with a healthcare provider.

questions.title: Which doctor or clinic do you normally go to?
questions.description: Identify the specific provider or facility where the appointment should be booked.

questions.title: Do you have that provider's contact details already?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to look up a phone number, website, or patient portal link before booking.

questions.title: What is your preferred timeframe for the appointment?
questions.description: Find out whether the user has a target date, week, or month in mind for the check-up.

questions.title: Are there specific days or times that work best for you?
questions.description: Capture scheduling constraints such as weekdays only, mornings, or after work hours.

questions.title: How do you prefer to book — phone, app, or online portal?
questions.description: Understand the user's preferred booking method so the right steps can be planned.

questions.title: Does your insurance require a referral for this visit?
questions.description: Check whether a referral step needs to be added to the plan before booking.

questions.title: Do you need a reminder set after the appointment is booked?
questions.description: Determine if a follow-up reminder or calendar event should be part of the task plan.
